Dear Trevor Shannon:

We are in receipt of BC Timber Sales, Chinook Business Area “Project Assurance Statements for Forest Service
Road Discontinue and Close FS301 Form” dated for reference March 31, 2025. As all conditions for road tenure
closure therein have been fulfilled for use and deactivation of the Forest Service Roads listed in SCHEDULE “A”
network is hereby Discontinued and Closed.

  Forest Service Road Discontinue and Close
  SCHEDULE “A”

map_readings.label: Schedule A map
map_readings.shows: Title of the map page. The side panel headed "Occupancy Agreement" lists under "BCTS Responsibility:" Anderson 7300 (8074.02), Anderson 7500 (8074.03), Anderson 7600 (8074.05) and Anderson 8900 (8074.06), and under "District Manager Responsibility:" Anderson 7400 (8074.04), each with the same 0+000m to end-station ranges as Schedule A. No gate, closure or deactivation symbols are drawn on the map; the legend has no closure category.

map_readings.label: 1 km
map_readings.shows: Km marker (black dot) on a green road (legend: Road Use Permit Section, RUP_SECTION_STATUS ISSUED) that climbs from the valley toward the short spur roads; one of a series of km markers on that road.

map_readings.label: 2 km
map_readings.shows: Km marker (black dot) on the same green road, at a switchback; a second "2 km" label also appears on a dashed road further west.

map_readings.label: 4 km
map_readings.shows: Km marker (black dot) on the same green road, just before it reaches the junction area where several short green spur roads branch off.

map_readings.label: 6 km
map_readings.shows: Km marker (black dot) on the green road north of the junction area, near the short green spur roads. The spur roads carry small labels beginning "ANDERSON" that are too small to read reliably at this image resolution, so which spur is which section cannot be read from the map.

map_readings.label: CK-2005
map_readings.shows: Black dot with a yellow label where the green road begins, at a dashed road near a creek; the map does not say what this point marks.

quotes.quote: network is hereby Discontinued and Closed.
